n = int(input())
probabilities = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
total_probability = 0

for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
    product = 1
    for i in range(n):
        if (mask >> i) & 1:
            product *= probabilities[0][i]
        else:
            product *= (100 - probabilities[0][i])
    total_probability += product

print(total_probability)
